# Fate UI v0.9.6-beta1

A feature prerelease: a device emulation toolbar for the browser pane, annotate rebuilt as an always-available picker, and a composer that forgives mistakes.

## Added

- **Device emulation toolbar.** The browser pane can now masquerade as a phone. A new toolbar row offers Chrome-style presets (iPhone SE through iPad Pro 11) plus exact width and height inputs, a rotate button, and translated touch input: while emulation is on, mouse events reach the page as finger touches, so mobile-only gesture handlers behave like they would on a real device. Emulation applies to every open tab at once and survives tab switches; one toggle restores desktop input.
- **Draft undo and redo in the composer.** Each conversation keeps its own history (up to 100 snapshots) and restores the cursor position and scroll offset, not just the text.

## Changed

- **Annotate is now a tool, not a mode.** The Agent/Annotate segmented switch is gone. Annotate became a toolbar toggle that runs the element picker as an overlay: agent interaction stays fully enabled while you annotate, and site access prompts now appear only when an origin grant is actually missing. Toggling annotate off returns direct clicks; Esc cancels a pick.
- **Pickers wait as long as you do.** Element picks and region drags no longer time out after 60 seconds; they stay armed until you click, drag, or cancel, like Chrome DevTools. When Chromium keeps dropping the picker, a bounded retry budget (12 re-arms) lets the loop rest instead of spinning every 250 ms forever.
- **Send button, rebuilt.** The hold-to-abort gesture is gone. The send button now shows a stop square while the agent runs with an empty input, and the prompt optimizer shows its spinner with a cancel on hover.
- **Auto-scroll settles after big prompts.** The conversation keeps following the bottom for a short settling window after you submit, so very large prompt rows finish measuring instead of stranding the view mid-jump. Manual scrolling still wins instantly.
- **Music dock yields to the browser pane.** When the browser pane shares the workspace above 820 px, the floating music dock slides left instead of covering the pane's toggle; below that width the pane stacks under the conversation and the dock keeps its corner.

## Fixed

- **Annotations survive project switches.** The annotation store no longer lives inside the disposable browser service. It is kept per normalized project path (bounded, six projects), so unsent annotation chips keep pointing at real data across focus switches, worktree activation, tab closes, and service rebuilds.
- **Stale annotations no longer break sends.** When the main process rejects a prompt because attached annotations are gone, the composer extracts the offending ids from the error and drops them from the draft instead of failing every later prompt.
- **Overlay numbers match the input box.** The browser overlay numbering now mirrors the composer's attachment list per conversation and resets after every send, so the two never disagree.

## Verification

- Local validation: TypeScript typecheck, the full unit suite (157 files, 1498 tests), and a production build.
- GitHub Actions runs the standard four-platform pipeline: build, install, and smoke test on Windows x64, macOS Apple Silicon, macOS Intel, and Linux x64.

## Notes

- Public beta installers are unsigned. Verify each download against the `SHA256SUMS` file shipped with the release.
